# PIDFaceplate

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Operator faceplate of a control loop (IND-030 .. IND-034).

!!! danger "Not a safety-related system"
    A controller in a notebook runs with no timing guarantee. It is for visualization, teaching, simulation and supervision; it is not a safety-related system and must not perform a safety function. See the [safety notice](../safety.md).

## Example

The traits of the picture above:

```python
ai.PIDFaceplate(
    label="PIDFaceplate",
    tag="TIC-101",
    unit="°C",
    pv=71.6,
    sp=75,
    op=62.5,
    modes=["MAN", "AUTO", "CAS"],
    pv_max=150,
    confirm_delta=10,
    lo=40,
    hi=110,
    hihi=130,
)
```

## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[240,236]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `tag` | string | `""` | host | Loop tag, e.g. TIC-101. |
| `unit` | string | `""` | host | Unit of PV and SP. |
| `op_unit` | string | `"%"` | host | Unit of OP. |
| `format` | string | `"%.1f"` | host | printf-like spec of the values (NUM-004). |
| `pv` | number | `"nan"` | host | Process value (measurement), set by the host. |
| `sp` | number | `0` | host | Setpoint, clamped to sp_min .. sp_max (or the PV range). Changed by the operator in AUTO (IND-031). |
| `op` | number | `0` | host | Output, clamped to op_min .. op_max. Changed by the operator in MAN. |
| `loop_mode` | `"MAN"`, `"AUTO"`, `"CAS"` | `"AUTO"` | host | Loop mode: MAN (operator sets OP), AUTO (operator sets SP), CAS (neither). Must be one of modes. |
| `modes` | array of enum | `["MAN","AUTO"]` | host | Modes offered on the faceplate. |
| `pv_min` | number | `0` | host | Lower end of the PV scale. |
| `pv_max` | number | `100` | host | Upper end of the PV scale. |
| `sp_min` | number or null | `null` | host | Lower setpoint limit; null: pv_min. |
| `sp_max` | number or null | `null` | host | Upper setpoint limit; null: pv_max. |
| `op_min` | number | `0` | host | Lower output limit. |
| `op_max` | number | `100` | host | Upper output limit. |
| `confirm_delta` | number or null | `null` | host | A change of SP or OP larger than this needs a confirmation (IND-032); null: never. |
| `sp_tracking` | boolean | `false` | host | Leaving MAN sets SP to PV (bumpless transfer, IND-034). |
| `lolo` | number or null | `null` | host | Low-low alarm limit on PV. |
| `lo` | number or null | `null` | host | Low alarm limit on PV. |
| `hi` | number or null | `null` | host | High alarm limit on PV. |
| `hihi` | number or null | `null` | host | High-high alarm limit on PV. |
| `deadband` | number | `0` | host | Alarm hysteresis (ALARM-003). |
| `alarm_level` | `"normal"`, `"lo"`, `"lolo"`, `"hi"`, `"hihi"` | `"normal"` | derived | Alarm level of pv. Derived: by the host when it owns the state, otherwise by the front end (HOST-004). |
| `value` | object | `{}` | derived | Summary {pv, sp, op, mode}. Derived: by the host when it owns the state, otherwise by the front end. |
